facts.fact: The National Bureau of Statistics' Demographic Statistics Bulletin 2022, published December 2023 (figures cover 2013-2022), says its data were compiled from the documents of relevant ministries, departments and agencies, citing the National Population Commission (vital statistics and projections), the Central Bank of Nigeria (remittances) and NAPTIP (trafficking in persons), and it reports NIN registrations 2019-2021.

The bulletin's preface calls it the seventh edition of the NBS publication series, dated December 2023 (publication date, not the year its figures cover), drawing on National Population Commission, Central Bank and NAPTIP records.
The NPC chairman said NPC is training data officers in advanced analytics to support the publication of vital statistics.

facts.fact: The National Bureau of Statistics held a two-day in-boarding training in Abuja and distributed hardware and software to 15 pilot ministries, departments and agencies for the World Bank-supported Integrated Systems of Administrative Statistics, whose MDAs were to sign a Data Supply Pledge to share administrative data regularly.
